title: Web Settings
text:
Breadcrumbs
The Web Settings centralizes customization of web application-specific settings to boost the product's performance and adaptability across web operations. It enables you to adjust settings directly, optimizing performance and the overall experience in diverse web environments.
The
Limit Salesforce Strategy
option within Web Settings
allows
you to restrict the number of strategies created for elements in Salesforce applications, preventing performance issues caused by too many strategies.
Note
: The screenshots on this page use the
Elegance Design
, introduced in
2025.3
. If you are using an earlier version, your layout may look different.
Limit Salesforce Strategy
The
Limit Salesforce Strategies
checkbox aims to prevent potential performance issues that could occur from generating too many strategies for a captured element in Salesforce applications.
Note:
The
Limit Salesforce Strategies
option is enabled by default.
The Strategy Count field is hidden when the Limit Salesforce Strategies option is disabled.
Strategy Count
The Strategy Count field lets you set the maximum number of strategies generated for elements in Salesforce. You can enter an integer between 1 and 2,147,483. If you enter a value outside this range, an error message will be displayed.
Note:
The default setting for the
Strategy Count Field
is 20.
The
Save
button saves all details.
Note: Web Settings
will expand to cover more web application configurations, making it a flexible platform for enhancing web application performance and user experience.
